sections.title: Wave 1 — View priority and mode persistence
Wave 6 — Visual and e2e verification gates

loops.stop_when: User approves screenshots or explicitly ends the effort

tasks.name: Planner: design Board/List/Canvas UX redesign task graph
tasks.model_rationale: Planning depth: reading a large UI surface + authoring a full spec/plan/task graph needs the highest-reasoning model; fable per Planner Profile guidance (fallback opus).
acceptance_criteria: Planner updates GOAL/Spec/Plan/Tasks in CodeTerm planner, not a standalone markdown plan.
Executable task graph exists with role_guidance, criteria, test plan, correctness for each lane.
Board-primary/List-second/Canvas-third, done-heavy behavior, detail inspectability, plan/spec context, canvas perf, and spec-entity presentation all addressed.
tasks.test_plan: codeterm plan state + codeterm plan doctor --kind quality; Orchestrator reviews graph before dispatch
tasks.correctness: Orchestrator can dispatch workers from tasks without rereading chat; replanning loop exists for feedback-driven iteration.
tasks.role_guidance: You are a Planner-profile structural Worker: durable planner state only; no agent spawning, no implementation, no pane assignment; report in_review to the Orchestrator.

cleanup_hints: Planning-state lane: do not remove project checkout; close planner pane after accepted report.

tasks.name: Planning-kind tasks: CLI/backend gating + doctor fix
tasks.model_rationale: Rust backend gating + doctor semantics; needs care around plan service invariants but scope is narrow — opus.
acceptance_criteria: plan task add --type planning succeeds on a mode=planning plan without --force; any other kind still errors with TaskCreationRequiresApproval.
plan doctor --kind quality: no tasks_before_approval for planning-kind tasks; execution-kind in planning mode still errors.
Doctor body check resolves externalized tasks/*.md bodies (no false 'task is missing body' when a body file exists).
docs/ORCHESTRATION.md + src-tauri/prompts/orchestration_toolset.md document the planning kind; revision tags bumped.
tasks.test_plan: cargo unit tests for gate+doctor (narrowed, single run); ./build.sh check; ./build.sh cli then manual scratch-plan verification on dev
tasks.correctness: Approval gate not weakened: only kind==planning bypasses; --force semantics unchanged; doctor stays deterministic (no prose heuristics).
tasks.role_guidance: You are a Rust backend Worker in src-tauri/src/service/plan only. No frontend changes. Follow lock-ordering rules; run one narrowed cargo test at a time.

tasks.name: Board-first view order + persisted mode
tasks.model_rationale: Mechanical, fully specified change with exact files and tests; no design judgment — sonnet is fast and sufficient.
acceptance_criteria: Opening a plan lands on Board; mode switch shows Board, List, Canvas in that order.
Chosen mode survives plan close/reopen and app restart (localStorage-backed).
planViewMode/PlanViewShell unit tests and plan-view-mode.spec.ts updated and green.
tasks.test_plan: npm run test:unit; npx playwright test -c tests/playwright --project=golden with dev on 7686
tasks.correctness: No view renders differently except default/order/persistence; resolvePlanViewMode still falls back safely on invalid stored values.
tasks.role_guidance: You are a frontend Worker in src/components/Canvas. Scope is ONLY view-mode order/default/persistence and its tests. Do not restyle views or touch board/list/canvas internals. Report in_review when tests pass.

tasks.name: Shared PlanDetailOverlay (view-agnostic detail surface)
tasks.model_rationale: Architectural seam extraction (decoupling canvas node types from a shared surface) with regression risk in canvas UX — opus.
acceptance_criteria: PlanDetailOverlay renders task/plan/spec kinds from model-level props with Esc close + focus trap; used by Canvas via a thin adapter.
No duplicated detail-rendering logic: DetailContent remains the single body renderer.
Existing canvas overlay behavior unchanged (camera untouched, section nav, open-pane action).
tasks.test_plan: npm run test:unit (new PlanDetailOverlay.test.tsx + existing canvas tests); manual dev check of canvas card expand
tasks.correctness: Board/List can import and open the overlay without importing canvas layout modules; file sizes stay under 1000 lines.
tasks.role_guidance: You are a frontend Worker owning src/components/Canvas/planView + CanvasDetailOverlay/DetailContent. Contract: PlanDetailOverlay takes model-level props only — no LaidOutNode/canvas types may leak into planView/. Canvas expand behavior must remain pixel-identical.

tasks.name: Spec card + spec read surface redesign
tasks.model_rationale: Canvas render pipeline (cardContent/drawCard) + information design judgment for the spec summary — opus.
acceptance_criteria: Canvas spec card shows title, section count, coverage rollup, readable top-level sections; no identical per-row '-> tasks' chips; no dead space.
Spec detail (shared overlay) shows the full untruncated section tree with per-section coverage and linked tasks.
cardContent/drawCard unit tests updated and green.
tasks.test_plan: npm run test:unit; manual dev screenshots of spec card at 100% and overview zoom for the report
tasks.correctness: Spec information is never destroyed by truncation — everything cropped has an expand path; Board/List reach the same spec detail via PlanContextHeader.
tasks.role_guidance: You are a frontend Worker in src/components/Canvas/canvasRender (+ PlanDetailOverlay spec kind). Kill truncation-noise: no cropped strings without an expand path, no identical per-row chips. Renderer-only; no data-layer changes.

tasks.name: Board redesign (primary view)
tasks.model_rationale: Primary-surface visual design + interaction + model work; design quality is the whole point — opus with a frontend-design stance.
acceptance_criteria: Plan-context header band (goal/focus/owner/progress/spec) replaces the floating summary cards; click-through opens plan/spec detail.
Done column collapsed by default (recent 5 + count + Show-all scrolling in-column); page height bounded on the 200-done fixture.
Cards clickable -> task detail overlay; columns scroll independently with sticky headers; empty columns read cheaply.
Existing plan-board-* testids preserved; plan-board-done-toggle + plan-context-header added.
tasks.test_plan: npm run test:unit (boardModel + PlanBoardView tests); dev visual pass on real plan + done-heavy fixture; 2 screenshots attached to report
tasks.correctness: No unbounded growth with done count; no per-render fetch regressions; multi-plan workspace stacking still works.
tasks.role_guidance: You are a frontend UX Worker owning planView/PlanBoardView, boardModel, BoardTaskCard, PlanContextHeader (new) and .plan-board-* CSS. Design bar: calm, dense, readable; var(--ct-*) tokens only; check both dark and light. PlanContextHeader must be reusable by List. Depends on t1-view-order + t2-detail-overlay.

tasks.name: List redesign (secondary view)
tasks.model_rationale: Interaction + collapse-model design decisions affecting readability; same design bar as Board — opus.
acceptance_criteria: Task rows open detail overlay; section rows collapse/expand; done-only sections default collapsed with 'n done' rollups.
Status filter chips + text filter work; done rows visually quiet; sticky plan header present.
buildPlanListTree/PlanListView unit tests updated and green; plan-list-collapse-toggle, plan-list-filter, plan-list-done-rollup testids added.
tasks.test_plan: npm run test:unit; dev visual pass on normal + done-heavy fixture; 2 screenshots attached to report
tasks.correctness: List page height bounded on done-heavy fixture; row identity stable so e2e selectors survive; no canvas imports.
tasks.role_guidance: You are a frontend UX Worker owning planView/PlanListView + buildPlanListTree (+ optional listViewState). Keep List dense — rows, not cards. Reuse PlanContextHeader from t3-board and PlanDetailOverlay from t2-detail-overlay; do not fork either.

tasks.name: Canvas legibility + performance (LOD, zoom floor, done compression)
tasks.model_rationale: Canvas render pipeline + perf instrumentation; subtle hit-testing/LOD invariants — opus.
acceptance_criteria: No dot-cloud state exists: below readability threshold the world renders per-section cluster chips with counts/presence.
Min-zoom clamp in place; done tasks compress into per-section done-stacks at normal zoom.
Pan/zoom on 200-done+10-active fixture: p95 frame time ~16ms or better, with before/after numbers reported.
Unit tests updated (drawCard, hitTest, useCanvasViewport); minimap consistent with LOD world.
tasks.test_plan: npm run test:unit; ./build.sh dev + manual pan/zoom with useCanvasFrameProbe numbers; watch dev log for LONGTASK
tasks.correctness: Cluster hit-testing routes clicks correctly (cluster -> section focus, stack -> expand); zero behavior change above the LOD threshold.
tasks.role_guidance: You are a frontend perf Worker in src/components/Canvas/canvasRender + useCanvasViewport + CanvasMinimap. Renderer-only: no REST/data changes, no new canvas features. Every perf claim needs frame-probe numbers in the report.

tasks.name: Playwright visual/e2e gate for plan views
tasks.model_rationale: Test authoring against existing Playwright patterns and helpers; well-templated work — sonnet.
acceptance_criteria: plan-view-mode.spec.ts covers Board default, Board/List/Canvas order, persistence across close/reopen.
Detail overlay open/close verified from Board card, List row, Canvas card, with state restoration.
Done-heavy fixture assertions: bounded board height, collapsed done column, list rollups.
Screenshot artifacts for Board/List/Canvas/spec-card/spec-detail on normal + done-heavy fixtures, paths listed in report.
tasks.test_plan: npx playwright test -c tests/playwright --project=golden; npm run test:pw:lint
tasks.correctness: Specs pass deterministically (no arbitrary sleeps); selectors use testids agreed in t3/t4/t5; failures point at the owning wave.
tasks.role_guidance: You are a QA Worker in tests/playwright/suites/13-canvas. Web-mode on macOS against dev 7686. Follow tests/playwright/README.md conventions and tag hygiene. Your screenshots are the user-facing visual evidence — frame them cleanly.

tasks.name: Adversarial review + integration gate
tasks.model_rationale: Cross-lane adversarial review judging against acceptance gates; highest-leverage quality step — fable (fallback opus).
acceptance_criteria: Per-lens findings delivered (untouched-flow regressions, perf, discipline, contract stability) with file:line references.
Every acceptance gate from the spec has an explicit pass/fail line with evidence.
Verdict: approve or a concrete bounce list naming owning task handles.
tasks.test_plan: npm run lint; npm run test:unit; bash scripts/check-file-sizes.sh; npx playwright test -c tests/playwright --project=golden; ./build.sh check
tasks.correctness: No gate is claimed green without command output evidence; visual acceptance explicitly deferred to the user via Orchestrator.
tasks.role_guidance: You are an adversarial code-review Worker. You do NOT fix code — you produce findings and a verdict. Review the integrated diff of all lanes against the spec acceptance gates; run every gate command yourself; be specific (file:line).

tasks.name: Replanning checkpoint (standing feedback loop)
tasks.model_rationale: Replanning requires the same planning depth as the original graph — fable Planner (fallback opus). Kind=planning: this is planner-state work, not execution.
acceptance_criteria: Every structural blocker or failed visual gate routes through a Planner revision instead of inline Orchestrator improvisation.
Each loop iteration ends with re-run plan state + doctor and an explicit dispatch decision.
Closed only when the user accepts the visuals or ends the effort.
tasks.test_plan: Inspect plan strides/handoffs after each iteration: replanning evidence (screenshots, revised sections/tasks) is recorded on the plan
tasks.correctness: Loop respects budget (3 iterations then mandatory user conversation); tactical fixes stay with workers without a Planner round-trip.
tasks.role_guidance: Orchestrator-owned contract task: when triggered, spawn a Planner-profile worker with current screenshots + failing reports + a one-paragraph problem statement; do not improvise large redesigns inline.

tasks.name: Task executor-role field: model + CLI + doctor warning
tasks.model_rationale: Rust model/CLI/doctor change mirroring t0's surface; narrow but touches persistence round-trip — opus; sequence with or after t0-planning-kind (same files, avoid conflict).
acceptance_criteria: plan task add/update accept --role; value persists and round-trips through plan.json/body_files.
task show, plan get, and plan state open-lanes display executor_role.
Doctor warns (not errors) on execution-kind tasks missing executor_role; planning-kind exempt.
All 12 tasks of this plan backfilled with executor_role; docs + agents.md vocabulary updated with revision bumps.
tasks.test_plan: narrowed cargo test (single run); ./build.sh check; ./build.sh cli; backfill on this plan + plan state output pasted in report
tasks.correctness: Structural AgentRole hierarchy untouched (Orchestrator/Worker only); role composes with role_guidance at spawn (role = who, guidance = how); no hard enum blocking future vocabularies.
tasks.role_guidance: You are a Rust backend Worker in src-tauri/src/service/plan (+ CLI arg wiring). Coordinate with t0-planning-kind lane — same module; take it in the same worktree/lane if dispatched together. No frontend changes. Loose slug validation only: do NOT create a structural role enum.

goal.vector: Make the CodeTerm planning workspace visually pleasant, understandable, and efficient, with Board as the primary view, List second, Canvas third; every view must make plan/spec/tasks inspectable without awkward scrolling or hidden context.
constraints: Board is the default/primary planning view; List is second; Canvas is third.
Task details, plan context, and spec context must be openable from Board and List.
Done tasks must not create unbounded vertical scroll or visually dominate active work.
Canvas must avoid laggy tiny unreadable overviews and should degrade gracefully for large plans.
postulates: This is a UX/UI redesign planning effort first; implementation tasks must be generated by the Planner after studying current UI and screenshots.
The Orchestrator executes the plan and returns to Planner for replanning when implementation evidence or user feedback shows the plan is weak.
